8 Hanover Square is an ultra-prime, 63,958 sq ft office building, comprising 55,880 sq ft of office accommodation over 1st – 7th floors, and two retail units totalling 8,078 sq ft at ground and lower ground. There are 11 parking spaces at basement, accessed from the rear courtyard, together with 98 cycle spaces. There is a 7,000 sq ft adjoining residential building that provides 5 x 2-bedroom apartments and 1 x 3-bedroom duplex penthouse. The office accommodation is single let to Perenco Holdings on a lease expiring in 2027. The current total passing rent is £6.9m The building was acquired in 2013. Phase 1 of the Business Plan entailed its subsequent redevelopment and leasing, with completion achieved in 2017. Total capital expenditure to completion (including acquisition) was £142.3m. The most recent valuation is £187.6m. The current second phase of the business plan is to hold the asset indefinitely, optimising the rental income to provide a secure long-term investment.

businessPlanRows.developmentSummary: The business plan is to collect full rent from the single tenant, The London School of Accounting, until their lease expiry in August 2025. Thereafter, secure vacant possession. In the interim period, we will select and instruct a professional team to design a high-quality scheme that retains the existing structure (in the main) and maximises massing. During the early stages of design, MRE maintained frequent dialogue with Camden Planning. The planning application was submitted in April 2025 and a resolution to grant consent subject to a S106 Agreement and GLA Approval was obtained in October 2025. The goal is to reposition the building through comprehensive redevelopment involving partial demolition, new façade, new MEPH throughout, reconfiguration of the three existing cores into one consolidated compliant core and upward extension to provide four additional floors of office space and a pavilion at level 10 creating amenity space, and introduction flexible retail space and jewellery workspace across ground and lower ground floors, delivering c.94,000 best-in-class Grade A building. Thereafter, the plan is to lease the building at prime rents and to then hold indefinitely within the BNF portfolio.
